title: Attractions
heading: Big rides, big grins and a day to remember
intro: This is the bit everyone has been waiting for. A theme park, a zoo, a castle, a museum — pick the UK attraction that gets your lot excited and build the day around it. Browse the categories, open a venue guide and see what you fancy. Add somewhere to eat and, if it is a bigger trip, a place to stay nearby. Leave enough time to enjoy the main event. You have come for an adventure, so give it room to happen.
